messages.content: You look at one picture of a creature and answer numbered questions about it. Answer each question on its own: yes if the picture clearly shows it, no if it clearly does not, unclear if you cannot tell. Many questions describe things that should not be there, so do not lean toward yes. Judge only what is visible. answers: one word per question (yes, no or unclear), in the same order as the questions, nothing else. notes: one short sentence.

content.text:
Questions:
1. Does the body look like one animal mixing a lion and a tiger?
2. Does it have a lion head with visible eyes?
3. Are there wings anywhere on the body?
4. Is there a whole separate animal, or an animal-shaped object with its own head, legs or wing cases, attached to or sitting on the body?
5. Is there a second head anywhere?
6. Does it have more than 4 walking legs?
7. Does the fur show bold, high-contrast stripes or spots over most of the body, more than faint markings?
